An app? For a shower? Why on earth do you need a telephone to get wet, Julian? In my day, you used your hand to feel the water, not a computer screen.

It’s not efficient, it’s lazy! You're letting a machine tell you when you're clean. Now listen to me. What step do you take to take a shower?
I turn the water on, and once it gets warm, I go in.
